changelog: - **Reset view takes the whole selection off at once.** After View ▸ Reset view, a selected node kept its ring, the right panel still said “1 node selected” and the Model list kept its row marked, while the properties and Focus mode already said that nothing was selected. Reset view now clears every one of them together: for a node, for a connection, for several at once, and also under the edit lock. One click selects the same node or connection again. The phone’s two Reset views, the More sheet’s row and the button on the canvas, do the same.
